name: Ardley
description: Houses are large and set well apart on generous lots. Schools, stores and restaurants are several miles away, so you drive for all of them. Almost everyone here grew up nearby, and families tend to settle for good.

name: Bellamy
description: Houses are large and set well apart on generous lots. Schools, stores and restaurants are several miles away, so you drive for all of them. Some families here go back generations, and others came in the last decade.

name: Corvin
description: Houses are roomy and set out along curving roads. Schools, stores and restaurants are a ten-minute drive off, so you drive for most of them. Almost everyone here grew up nearby, and families tend to settle for good.
